messages.subject: errors on runModels()
messages.body_plain:
Hello.
i want to test sem in R using MplusAutomation but i always have the same problem
when i execute runmodels i dont find file .out in my folder.

i use mplus demo 7.11

my code is
ds = read.csv("http://www.math.smith.edu/r/data/help.csv")
attach(ds)
library(MplusAutomation)
cesdcut = ifelse(cesd>20, 1, 0)
smallds = na.omit(data.frame(homeless, cesdcut,
satreat, linkstatus))
prepareMplusData(smallds, file="mplus.dat")
createModels("mplus.txt")
runModels()
summary=extractModelSummaries()
models=readModels()

my mplus.txt file is
[[init]]
iterators = classes;
classes = 1:4;
dir = "Z:/field/blog";

STARTS = 2000 200;

messages.subject: Mixtures with class covariates.
messages.body_plain:
Hi.
First of all, thanks for the package :)

I've found small annoying thing when reading parameters from a 3 or more classes mixture model with covariates.
If I delete the "ALTERNATIVE PARAMETERIZATIONS FOR THE CATEGORICAL LATENT VARIABLE REGRESSION" section in the output Mplus file then it works OK.
Otherwise, the parameters read in R
 readModels(target = outFile )$parameters$unstandardized
get a bit 'confused'

Find attached an example of .out file
